description: The line plot illustrates the performance change in terms of minimum FDE₂₀ (minFDE₂₀) as a function of the ratio of the in-context pool size, with lower values indicating better performance. The x-axis, labeled "Ratio," ranges from 0.2 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2, representing the proportion of the in-context pool. The y-axis, labeled "minFDE₂₀ (←)", ranges from 18 to 23, with lower values signifying improved performance. The plot compares five different methods: TrajICL (blue, solid line with circular markers), Head Tuning (orange, solid line with circular markers), FT (green, solid line with circular markers), LoRA 16 (red, solid line with circular markers), and LoRA 64 (purple, solid line with circular markers). TrajICL shows a steep decline in minFDE₂₀ from approximately 20.4 at a ratio of 0.2 to 18.1 at a ratio of 1.0. Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64 all exhibit relatively stable performance across the range of ratios, with values hovering around 22.5 to 23.0 at a ratio of 0.2, and a slight decrease to around 22.0 to 22.5 at a ratio of 1.0. The legend is positioned in the upper right corner of the plot.
